Case 1 (lamp 1 chosen): lamp 2 is forbidden, so choose 2 non-adjacent lamps from positions 3 through 10:
\[
\binom{(8-2)+1}{2}=\binom{7}{2}=21.
\]
By symmetry, Case 2 (lamp 10 chosen) also gives \(21\).

Intersection: both lamps 1 and 10 chosen, then the third lamp must be chosen from positions 3 through 8:
\[
6.
\]

Thus valid ways:
\[
\binom{8}{3}-21-21+6=56-42+6=20.
\]
\[
\boxed{20}
\]
